segments.title: The herdr-projects board
segments.narration: where-der puts your herder-projects board in one clear view. herder-projects runs the tasks, coordinators and project management; where-der makes them easy to use.
segments.caption: wherdr puts your herdr-projects board in one clear view. herdr-projects runs the tasks, coordinators and project management; wherdr makes them easy to use.

segments.title: Four columns
segments.narration: The board is optional: where-der also works with Herder alone. Here, tasks sit in four columns: Needs you, Ready to approve, Working, and To do.
segments.caption: The board is optional: wherdr also works with Herdr alone. Here, tasks sit in four columns: Needs you, Ready to approve, Working, and To do.

segments.title: Start with Needs you
segments.narration: Start with Needs you. The card shows the question that is blocking the agent. Click it to open the task.
segments.caption: Start with Needs you. The card shows the question that is blocking the agent. Click it to open the task.

segments.title: Read the task
segments.narration: The task opens beside the board, and all four columns stay in view. In the Task tab, read the question and the description.
segments.caption: The task opens beside the board, and all four columns stay in view. In the Task tab, read the question and the description.

segments.title: Ready to approve
segments.narration: Close the panel. Ready to approve works the same way: open a task, and the Task tab gathers the summary, the review and the pull request.
segments.caption: Close the panel. Ready to approve works the same way: open a task, and the Task tab gathers the summary, the review and the pull request.

segments.title: Check progress
segments.narration: Close it again for the overview. Working shows each task's progress, and To do holds what comes next.
segments.caption: Close it again for the overview. Working shows each task's progress, and To do holds what comes next.

segments.title: Keep moving
segments.narration: Use where-der to follow your herder-projects board, spot the next decision, and keep moving.
segments.caption: Use wherdr to follow your herdr-projects board, spot the next decision, and keep moving.
